title: Placement
description: Which free region of osu!'s layout to use. auto: osu! the band right of the playfield (left of the key counter), osu!taiko under the lane on the left, osu!mania beside the stage on the right. left/right pick the other side. On results the strip sits in the right part of the header.

title: Nudge X / px
description: Moves the overlay horizontally from its placement (1920×1080 pixels), for skins that put things elsewhere.

title: Nudge Y / px
description: Moves the overlay vertically from its placement (1920×1080 pixels).

title: osu!mania ColumnStart
description: Overrides the skin's [Mania] ColumnStart (480-line skin units) used to keep clear of the stage. 0 = read from the current skin through vosu.

title: osu!mania ColumnWidth
description: Overrides the skin's [Mania] ColumnWidth (one value for every column, skin units). 0 = read from the current skin through vosu.

title: Rolling window / hits
description: How many recent hits each point of the mean and UR traces averages. Smaller reacts faster but is noisier. Clamped to 10–500.

title: Chart height / px
description: Height of the gameplay chart. Clamped to 96–200 px.

title: Show UR trace
description: Adds a second lane with the rolling unstable rate under the mean trace.

title: Show on results
description: Keeps the whole attempt's curve on the results screen, where osu! shows no timing over time. Song select and menus never show the overlay.

title: Backing
description: none floats directly on the game; scrim adds a soft shade that fades out; panel draws a graphite panel.

title: Accent
description: map tints the live marker with the current map's colour (from its background); 18-lab keeps amber. Early/late colours never change.

title: Show 18—LAB tag
description: The small brand tag before the overlay name.
